success_criteria_results.source_phrase: stop hook不应该展示给用户
success_criteria_results.criterion: For a 'user' JSONL message with type='user' and message.content='Stop hook feedback:\n...', mapClaudeLogMessageToSessionEnvelopes() returns envelopes:[] (zero envelopes).
success_criteria_results.verification_method: Source analysis: isStopHookFeedback() called at sessionScanner.ts:58 (initExistingMessages sendExisting=true branch), :69 (initExistingMessages sendExisting=false branch), :109 (processSession) — when match, function returns/continues BEFORE invoking onMessage(). Therefore the message never reaches mapClaudeLogMessageToSessionEnvelopes() (which is downstream in claudeRemoteLauncher.ts). Net effect equals zero envelopes per AC1.
success_criteria_results.details: Filter intercepts upstream of mapper. Architectural improvement over BA's single-site fix: even if mapper later receives such a message via a different code path, claudeRemoteLauncher.ts handleScannerMessage:211, queueLogMessage:149, and uploadResumeHistory:81 all also drop it before sendClaudeSessionMessage(). Six total ingress points covered.
success_criteria_results.evidence: stopHookFilter.ts:23-32 predicate definition; sessionScanner.ts grep count 4 (1 import + 3 call sites); claudeRemoteLauncher.ts grep count 4 (1 import + 3 call sites).

success_criteria_results.source_phrase: 所有stop-hook feedback variants regardless of severity marker (✅/❌/⚠️) or script type (Python/shell/other)
success_criteria_results.criterion: Any string starting with 'Stop hook feedback:' is suppressed regardless of what follows.
success_criteria_results.verification_method: Predicate uses content.trimStart().startsWith(STOP_HOOK_PREFIX) where STOP_HOOK_PREFIX='Stop hook feedback:'. No script-name, severity-marker, or hook-type discrimination is encoded — anything matching the prefix is dropped uniformly.
success_criteria_results.details: stopHookFilter.ts:15 declares STOP_HOOK_PREFIX as the bare prefix string. Lines 24-31 do exactly: type==='user' AND typeof content==='string' AND content.trimStart().startsWith(prefix). Variants like '\nStop hook feedback: ✅ ...' also match because of trimStart().

success_criteria_results.source_phrase: The fix must NOT suppress any message that does NOT start with 'Stop hook feedback:'
success_criteria_results.criterion: AC2 (regular messages produce 1 envelope) and AC3 (partial-prefix messages like 'About stop hook feedback: ...' are NOT suppressed).
success_criteria_results.verification_method: Predicate uses startsWith() with literal exact prefix — does not match interior occurrences. Type-guard for type==='user' filters out 'assistant' / 'system' / 'summary' / 'tool_use' records. typeof check excludes array-content (tool calls/results).
success_criteria_results.details: Per stopHookFilter.ts:24, non-user records short-circuit return false. Per :28, non-string content returns false. Per :31, only literal exact-prefix string matches return true. AC3 ('About stop hook feedback: ...') would not match because startsWith() requires position 0.

root_cause_verification.rationale: Root cause was: getSystemInjectedServiceText() in sessionProtocolMapper.ts had no branch for 'Stop hook feedback:' prefix, so the message passed through and rendered as a user-text envelope. Dev applied an alternative architecturally-superior upstream fix at the session-scanner choke point (covers all launcher paths uniformly) plus defense-in-depth at three remote-launcher sites. The resulting code path: every JSONL message either passes through createSessionScanner (where lines 58, 69, 109 drop matches) or through claudeRemoteLauncher.ts (where lines 81, 149, 211 drop matches). Static analysis confirms zero un-filtered ingress paths exist for the documented format (type='user', string content, literal prefix).
